overall.summary: Every tool call captures telemetry (server_call_tool event) and tracks usage statistics, with conditional feedback prompt injection into results. Startup enables telemetry by default, persists tool history to disk, and preloads Chrome/PDF support. File operations capture detailed telemetry including file extensions and sizes. The implementation includes extensive undocumented behaviors around telemetry collection, usage tracking, and result modification that are not mentioned in tool descriptions.

startup.behaviour: Telemetry enabled by default, sends events to https://telemetry.desktopcommander.app/mp/collect (with fallback to Cloud Run URL). Captures tool calls, errors, file operations, process executions, and system metadata (platform, container info, runtime source, client info).
startup.evidence: utils/capture.js: capture() function called throughout; TELEMETRY_PROXY_URL constant; config-manager.js: getDefaultConfig() sets telemetryEnabled: true

startup.behaviour: UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE environment variable set to 16 if not already set, before any filesystem operations.
Configuration loaded from ~/.claude-server-commander/config.json on startup. File is created if missing, recovered if corrupt, and watched for changes via fs.watch.
startup.evidence: config-manager.js: ConfigManager.init(), loadStartupConfig(), startConfigWatcher(); config.js: CONFIG_FILE path

startup.behaviour: Chrome browser preloaded in background for PDF generation via ensureChromeAvailable().
Excel, DOCX, and PDF support packages preloaded via preloadFileSupport() after initialization.
Tool call history persisted to ~/.claude-server-commander/tool-history.jsonl. Keeps last 1000 entries in memory, trims file when over 5MB. Outputs over 4KB replaced with omission marker.
startup.evidence: utils/toolHistory.js: ToolHistory class, historyFile path, MAX_ENTRIES, MAX_HISTORY_FILE_SIZE_BYTES

startup.behaviour: Installation tracking sends telemetry event 'package_installed' to proxy URLs during npm install, including installation source detection (smithery, npx, npm, docker, etc.).

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_edit_block' with fileExtension, string lengths, expectedReplacements
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: edit.js: performSearchReplace() calls capture('server_edit_block', ...)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Performs fuzzy search with 0.7 similarity threshold when exact match not found, logs results to fuzzy-search.log
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: edit.js: performSearchReplace() calls runFuzzySearchInWorker(), fuzzySearchLogger.log()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Routes to handler.editRange() for structured files (Excel, DOCX) instead of text replacement
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: edit.js: handleEditBlock() checks hasEditRange and calls handler.editRange()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Clears virtual Node.js session from map instead of terminating process
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: forceTerminate() checks virtualNodeSessions.has(pid)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Returns additional config fields not listed in description: clientId, usageStats, feedbackGiven, sawOnboardingPage, pendingWelcomeOnboarding, welcomeOnboardingEligible
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: config-manager.js: getDefaultConfig() includes these fields; getConfig() returns full config object

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Uses file handler to get type-specific metadata (Excel sheets, PDF pages, image info, text line counts)
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: getFileInfo() calls getFileHandler() and handler.getInfo()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Trims history file when over 5MB to target of 4MB, keeping most recent entries
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: utils/toolHistory.js: trimHistoryFileIfTooLarge() called in loadFromDisk() and flushToDisk()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_interact_with_process' with pid and inputLength
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: interactWithProcess() calls capture('server_interact_with_process', ...)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Executes Node.js code via temp file for virtual node:local sessions
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: interactWithProcess() calls executeNodeCode() for virtual sessions

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Cleans output by removing REPL prompts and input echoes
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: interactWithProcess() calls cleanProcessOutput()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Returns [FILE] for a path that is a file instead of erroring
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: listDirectory() checks stats.isFile() and returns file entry

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Includes virtual Node.js sessions in output alongside real process sessions
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: listSessions() includes virtualSessions from virtualNodeSessions map

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Validates both source and destination paths with symlink resolution before moving
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: moveFile() calls validatePath() with entry: true for both paths

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_read_file' with fileExtension, offset, length, fileSize
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: readFileFromDisk() calls capture('server_read_file', ...)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: 3-minute timeout (READ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS) for read operations, cancellable via AbortSignal
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: READ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_MS constant, runWithAbortableTimeout() call

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Falls back to directory listing if path is a directory instead of returning error
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: readFileFromDisk() checks stats.isDirectory() and calls listDirectory()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Resolves symlinks and Windows junctions to real paths during validation
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: validatePath() calls resolveRealPath() which follows symlinks

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Each file read captures telemetry via readFile() internal calls
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: readMultipleFiles() calls readFile() which captures telemetry

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Waits for new output to arrive when offset=0 and session is active (polls every 50ms)
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: readProcessOutput() calls waitForOutput() when offset === 0

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Reports buffer cap eviction when output exceeds 50MB per session
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: readProcessOutput() checks result.evictedLines

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Can set undocumented config keys: clientId, usageStats, feedbackGiven, sawOnboardingPage, pendingWelcomeOnboarding, welcomeOnboardingEligible
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: config-manager.js: setValue() accepts any key; config stores these fields

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_telemetry_opt_out' when telemetryEnabled is set to false
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: config-manager.js: setValue() calls capture('server_telemetry_opt_out', ...)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_start_process' with command and commands (extracted first words)
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: startProcess() calls capture('server_start_process', ...)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Automatically enhances SSH commands by adding -t flag if not present
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: terminal-manager.js: executeCommand() adds ' -t' to ssh commands

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Repairs corrupted PATHEXT environment variable on Windows before spawning shell
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: terminal-manager.js: getRepairedPathExt() called in executeCommand()

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Creates virtual Node.js session for 'node:local' command instead of spawning process
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: improved-process-tools.js: startProcess() checks for 'node:local' and creates virtual session

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Uses ripgrep for file searches with fallback to Node.js implementation if ripgrep fails
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: searchFiles() imports searchManager which uses ripgrep

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_write_file' with fileExtension, mode, contentBytes, lineCount
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: writeFile() calls capture('server_write_file', ...)

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Rejects write to existing non-empty file if mode not explicitly specified (prevents accidental data loss)
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem-handlers.js: handleWriteFile() checks existing file size when mode not provided

undocumented_behaviours.behaviour: Captures telemetry event 'server_write_pdf' with fileExtension, contentLength/operationCount, mode
undocumented_behaviours.evidence: filesystem.js: writePdf() calls capture('server_write_pdf', ...)
